column2: A family can't stay in their home tonight. Somewhere in our fifteen thousand properties is the right place for them. Here's how the Property Map finds it.
Press Control K, or click Claims. Every claim waiting on housing is listed, with what the family needs. Pick one, and the map centers on their home.
The claim card shows the family, their pets, the budget and any special requests. No more digging through Monday.
Choose how far to look, then narrow it down: pets allowed, photos, or rent listed. Hover a result, and the map shows you exactly where it is.
Every property has a colour. Green, we've worked with them before. Yellow, it's in our database. Red, do not use. You know who to call first.
Each result also says if it's available, if it's already on another claim, and when we last spoke to the owner.
Open one to see if it fits the family, and exactly what it costs to move in. Every deposit and fee, added up for you.
Call or text the owner right from here. It goes out from your own Quo number, and the text is already written.
And you don't log the call. Monday's Last Contact Date updates by itself, with a short note of who called, and for how long.
Afterwards, Owner said shows what they told you. The date, the rent, the deposit, pets. Tap Update Monday, and the form fills itself in.
Check it, press Save, and Monday and the map change together, with a note of who changed what.
Happy with it? Add to claim, and it's on the Monday claim, distance and all.
When the shortlist is ready, Send summary writes a clean email to the relocation specialist, and logs it on the claim.
It works on your phone, too.
Pick a claim. Find the home. Call, add, and send. All from one screen, while Monday keeps itself up to date.
